answer: Each dawn, a tournament opens: every identity stakes a 50-credit bond and shows reviewed work; losers burn their bonds while winners advance. Matches are fought on the dune grounds, where scripted work loses round after round: 1,000 fakes burn nearly all 50,000 credits for a 40,000 prize pool. A rented referee approving a clone loses its wreath and seat, and an honest agent pays one bond once and keeps its juniper wreath on a clean run.
